tables.name: email_filter_rules
tables.purpose: User-trained junk-mail rules. Applied by the Outlook sync as Gate 1.5 between the hand-coded noise filter (_is_noise_email) and the heuristic classifier. Each rule matches on sender_pattern, sender_domain, subject_pattern, body_pattern (ILIKE) and emits action skip/review/allow.
tables.notesForAi: Reads in backend/src/services/integrations/microsoft_graph/user_filter_rules.py. Writes from frontend/src/app/api/email-filter-rules/ (admin-only POST/PATCH/DELETE). Allow actions short-circuit allowlist; skip drops the email with no DB writes; review writes to outlook_email_skip_audit only. NOT the same as outlook_inbox_rules: this is the SYNC-TIME junk gate (skip/review/allow); outlook_inbox_rules is the READ-TIME assistant-training layer (always-important / never-inbox / set priority|category) for the Outlook Draft Feedback inbox.

tables.name: outlook_inbox_rules
tables.purpose: Gmail/Outlook-style inbox rules for the Outlook Draft Feedback surface. Each rule matches a sender / sender_domain / subject / body / any pattern (contains, equals, starts_with, ends_with) and forces an assistant action: always_important, never_inbox, set_priority, or set_category. This trains the assistant on how to treat mail from a person/pattern.
tables.notesForAi: Applied at READ time in frontend/src/app/api/emails/route.ts (the pure matcher is frontend/src/lib/email-assistant/inbox-rules.ts) — NOT in the backend sync. Human reviews (outlook_email_assistant_reviews) always win over a rule; a rule overrides the derived triage guess. never_inbox drops the mail from the feed (count logged, never a silent hide) but never hides an email a human already reviewed. CRUD via frontend/src/app/api/outlook-inbox-rules/ (owner/admin/mailbox-owner gated, service client + RLS current_is_app_admin). Managed from the AI Review panel and /outlook-draft-feedback/rules. Distinct from email_filter_rules (the sync-time junk gate).

tables.gotchas: This is the cross-source status contract for Fireflies, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and future Acumatica-derived intelligence. Keep high-churn lifecycle rows in RAG, not PM APP. Terminal status `intentionally_excluded` (added 2026-06-30) marks documents the pipeline deliberately does NOT embed (interview-title meetings, sub-minimum low-content docs) — it is NOT a failure. Never count `intentionally_excluded` (or the historical `failed_permanent` rows carrying error_code `interview_title_excluded`/`skipped_low_content`) as a pipeline failure in health/alerting; only real `failed_retryable`/`failed_permanent` outcomes are failures. Status CHECK constraint enumerates allowed values.
